sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Column filter highlighting no longer misses a match that spans a comma/parenthesis/bracket boundary between two DOM text nodes — e.g. filtering an artist's Events tab for a query like "USA, bleach" against an Event cell whose native comment markup places a disambiguation alias directly before a bare comma (`…USA, Bleachers)`) correctly narrowed the row count but left the matching row with zero visible highlight spans.
